answer: To open a stall, an applicant stakes 38 coins for an 18-day lease on one community garden bed and raises a clerk-tagged sage whose leaf-vein hash is posted on day 5. On check day they must wander a 1.2 km towpath in one uncut 8-minute film with the pot RFID in every frame, then press the leaf to a clerk card whose stain must match a published nebula of 14 vein landmarks within 1.5 mm. Peers recompute the hash, check RFID continuity, and overlay the card. A reused plant or a missed landmark slashes the stake, so every alias needs its own living bed and walk.
